scope: Synthetic authorization and provisioning policy checks plus a fresh Kind v1.36.1 control plane and affirmative kubeadm worker enrollment under a unique approved DNS node name. Read-only observations cover Node/OS hostname/effective flags, Node Lease UID and renewal, public kubelet client-certificate identity, signed native CSR metadata, and declared Node authorizer/NodeRestriction configuration. The guide covers adoption-specific provisioning and provider checks.
